items.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Sub-Classification within Scheduled Castes
items.summary: A seven-judge Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court held that states are constitutionally empowered to create sub-classifications within Scheduled Castes (SCs) to ensure targeted affirmative action for the most backward subgroups.
key_takeaways: Requires quantifiable empirical data on inadequacy of representation.
Introduces the concept of applying the 'creamy layer' principle to SCs and STs.

items.title: BioE3 (Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and Employment) Policy
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the BioE3 Policy to drive high-performance biomanufacturing, aiming to transition India toward a green, bio-based circular economy.
key_takeaways: Focuses on bio-based chemicals, smart proteins, bioplastics, and precision therapeutics.
Establishes Bio-foundries and Bio-AI hubs across the country.
Supports India's net-zero carbon goals and green transition strategy.

items.title: Right to Protection against Climate Change under Article 21
items.summary: The Supreme Court recognized a distinct fundamental right to be free from the adverse impacts of climate change, grounding it under Article 21 (Right to Life) and Article 14 (Right to Equality).
key_takeaways: Explicitly links climate change impacts to fundamental rights.
Highlights the duty of the state to balance clean energy goals with biodiversity conservation.
Sets a global precedent for climate litigation in constitutional courts.

items.title: RBI Launches Unified Lending Interface (ULI)
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India rolled out the Unified Lending Interface (ULI) to streamline and democratize credit delivery, especially for MSMEs and rural borrowers.
key_takeaways: Enables seamless, consent-based digital data flow between lenders and data providers.
Reduces credit appraisal turnaround time dramatically.
Acts as a complementary platform to UPI for financial inclusion.

items.title: India-Iran 10-Year Long-Term Agreement on Chabahar Port
items.summary: India Ports Global Limited (IPGL) signed a 10-year contract with Iran to operate the Shahid Beheshti Terminal at Chabahar Port, securing India's strategic access to Central Asia and Eurasia.
key_takeaways: Provides trade access bypassing Pakistan via the INSTC (International North-South Transport Corridor).
Enhances India's maritime presence in the Western Indian Ocean.
Strengthens humanitarian assistance and trade linkages with Afghanistan and Central Asian Republics.
